conclusion.decision: Record the five surface outcomes without selecting a final learning rate, launching long confirmation, or promoting the result to paper-facing evidence.
conclusion.headline: Five independent Conv2 within-surface rho-corner outcomes were reviewed.
conclusion.interpretation: Each outcome applies only within its own scheme/optimizer surface; the diagnostic does not rank schemes or optimizers.
limitations: This is a targeted partial-grid ordinary-MNIST diagnostic.
Only seed 0 and a three-epoch budget were evaluated.
The official MNIST test set was not read.
No cross-scheme superiority or final learning-rate claim is supported.
conclusion.observation: All 20 planned cells are represented by hash-verified local artifacts, including reused controls and safety-stopped canaries.
